description: Subscribe an email address to free daily expiry monitoring of up to 5 domains (certificate, domain registration and security grade) with email alerts. Double opt-in: a confirmation email is sent and monitoring starts only after the recipient clicks the link. Use only an address the user owns and explicitly asked to use.

critDays.description: Days before expiry that count as CRITICAL "expiring soon" (default 15; must be < warnDays)

email.description: Email address that will receive the alerts

warnDays.description: Days before expiry that count as WARN (default 30; the default shrinks for short-lived certificates)

name: watch_expiry
